text:
I Tried TikTok's Bestselling K-Beauty Lip Oil: Noonis Apple Seed Lip Oil Review fashion beauty closets culture GIFT GUIDE Subscribe beauty TikTok's Bestselling K-Beauty Lip Oil Passed The Night-Out Test
 Here are my honest thoughts. 
 By Bianca Asare 
 Published Nov 16, 2026
 | 9:00am
 Coveteur editors select every item that appears on this page, and some items may be gifted to us. Additionally, Coveteur may earn compensation through affiliate links within the story. All prices are accurate upon date of publish. You can learn more about the affiliate process here. 
 I'm a beauty editor, so my response to hearing about a viral K-beauty lip oil that will keep my lips plump all night long was, "When can I try it?" No hesitation whatsoever. With hundreds of millions of views on TikTok, units selling faster than I can write a sentence, and ranking in Target's top 10 lip care products just weeks after launch, I knew that something had to be special about Nooni's Apple Seed Lip Oil before I even got my hands on it. "For us, the most exciting part of this journey is seeing how a product that gained traction through social media has evolved into a true omnichannel success story," Dino Ha, founder and CEO of Nooni, says. "TikTok helped introduce Nooni to millions of consumers, and our expansion into Target has allowed us to meet that demand on a much larger scale."
Known for effective ingredients, gentle formulas, and beyond reasonable price points, Korean beauty has made a major splash on the US market—so it's not surprising that this product captured the attention of TikTok users far and wide. But, how does it compare to other products? And can it meet a dry-skinned, dry-haired, dry-lipped beauty editor's standards? Ahead, my honest review.
 My Skin:
 As a dry-skinned gal, my skincare and makeup needs have always been pretty simple and straightforward: nothing that dries my skin out more than it naturally is, products that are easy to use, and results that last. When it comes to makeup, I like to keep my routine quite simple and contained to ten minutes or less. Although I will if I have to, I don't want to feel the need to constantly reapply a lip product because the moisture is gone or the color has faded. I'm on a personal mission to find lip products that offer results that last far beyond application.
 The Product:
 Nooni Lip Oil in AppleCranberry 
 $15 at target With over 5.2 million units sold worldwide, more than 450 million views on TikTok, and a lip oil selling every 30 seconds, the stats kind of speak for themselves. But it's not just any product that reaches viral status. With TikTok consumers being especially discerning and seeking noticeable results and authenticity, Nooni's lip oil had to check a few boxes to really break through. "The lip care category is incredibly competitive, but what sets Nooni apart is our ability to deliver innovative K-beauty formulations at an accessible price point without compromising on quality or performance," Ha says. "Our Apple Seed Lip Oil combines nourishing ingredients with a lightweight formula and high-shine finish that consumers genuinely love."
It's available in 8 shades, including a clear option that's formulated with super-nourishing apple seed oil for a glass-like shine. Other shades feature a pH-responsive formula that reveals a custom, personalized pink stain. And because it's on the market for $15 a pop, it's safe to say that this product checks a lot of boxes.
 The Results:
 Applecranberry Applepeony Although the five shades don't show up that distinctly different on my lips, there are good reasons why one of these will be on my person at all times moving forward. As a beauty editor who has tried her fair share of lip products, no product has left my lips looking as juicy, glossy, soft, and hydrated (all at the same time!) as this lip oil—and that result doesn't only last for a few minutes post-application, but throughout an evening where many sips of beverages are taken. I attribute this to the nourishing apple seed oil in the formula. As a lazy makeup girl who would prefer not to constantly reapply a lip product throughout the night for the sake of maintaining color, I'm obsessed with the slight stain that this lip oil leaves behind. 
 Worth It? 
 One of the major selling points of Nooni's Apple Seed Lip Oil is the price point: $15 a unit. Compared to other lip oils I've tried (Dior's at $42 and Typology's at $32.50, for example), the results are either on par or exponentially better. For me, this is a necessary reminder of how many brands might be unknown to us and how "luxury" status doesn't inherently mean a product will be better. 
 TL;DR:
 Every 30 seconds, a Nooni Apple Seed Lip Oil sells. With over 450 million views on TikTok and 5.2 million units sold worldwide, this product reached viral status before it was ever on team Coveteur's radar. But, better late than never. At $15 a unit, this lip oil delivers the same (or even better) results than luxury products at much higher price points. It's hydrating, leaves the lips looking juicy and plump, and leaves behind a very welcome flush of color.
